result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: New York law and exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts located in New York County. It also preserves the personal-jurisdiction waiver and temporary-injunctive-relief carveout. However, repeating the same New York County jurisdiction provision in both Sections 28.1 and 28.2 is unnecessary; the cleaner minimal revision would make Section 28.1 address New York governing law only and retain Section 28.2 as the exclusive forum provision.
